hidden.title: Where the sea meets the dunes
hidden.description: Khor Al Adaid is one of the few places on earth where the sea runs into the desert. Reach it with a licensed desert operator — never drive the dunes yourself — and film the moment the water appears.

hidden.title: The view the postcards miss
hidden.description: Somewhere on the marked trail above the grove there is an angle where the whole forest sits below you. Find it, from the path.

hidden.title: Where the soap dries
hidden.description: Nablus soap cures on rooftops in stacked towers. Ask a factory whether you may see theirs, and film the stacks if they say yes.

hidden.title: The arena after dark
hidden.description: Book an official evening opening and photograph the hypogeum lit from below.

hidden.title: The last light on the harbour
hidden.description: Photograph the fishing port in the last ten minutes of light, from the sea wall.

events.title: Hear it before you see it
events.description: Film the sound of a race weekend from inside the circuit grounds — the moment engines start, with your own reaction in frame.

events.title: A concert among the ruins
events.description: Byblos stages music inside the archaeological site. Film one minute of a set with the old stone behind the stage.

events.title: The gardens in flower
events.description: The Generalife gardens are worth a specific season. Photograph them at their peak.

events.title: Ramadan lanterns in Khan el-Khalili
events.description: Photograph the fanous lanterns filling the lanes. Seeded already-closed so the expired-event path is testable.

sponsored.title: Cook machboos with the chef
sponsored.description: Book the kitchen session, cook machboos start to finish alongside the chef, and film the moment the rice goes on top.

sponsored.title: Breakfast above the cloud line
sponsored.description: Some mornings the cloud sits below the lodge. Film breakfast with the valley filled in white underneath you.

sponsored.title: The guided tomb
sponsored.description: Take the official tour to a tomb that is normally closed, and explain one thing your guide told you that is not on any sign.
